ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountStatus_BOB] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus AS (

SELECT
    BBC.ID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BBC.UPDATE_DT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
	,BBC.STATUS AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
	,'BOB' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BBC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLCORPORATION BBC
WHERE  BBC.ISLATEST = 1
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus
WHERE (PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'BOB'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR,
	ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId,
	ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId,
    ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
	 	 WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
and SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' )



-----------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,'BOB' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON  DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;

END

BEGIN

convert(varchar,BAC.BAC_ID) AS CustomerAccountId

convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)

OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' )

),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'

and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
and SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL

PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
and  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' )
AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'ATM'


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus
(
CustomerAccountId 
,PeriodStartTimestamp 
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId 
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp 
,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON  DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS_CCD] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
    SELECT 
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STATUS AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
    ,CASE WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_STATUS IN ('5', '6', '7', 'A') THEN BCC.CRDACCT_CHGOFF_IND ELSE NULL END AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCC.CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,'CCD' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
    where BCC.isLatest = 1

UNION

    SELECT 
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR as CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_STATUS as CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
    ,CASE WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_STATUS IN ('5', '6', '7', 'A') THEN BCC.CRDACCT_CHGOFF_IND ELSE NULL END AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BCC.CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
     ,'CCD' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
    where BCC.isLatest = 1


)A
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus FROM  TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus WHERE RN = 1;
--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH 
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus
WHERE (PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' )
AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId,
    ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode,
    CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC SRC
    LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    and SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
   WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL

SET
PeriodEndTimestamp =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
and  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode

JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC

and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
 AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' )
AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'

CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusNote AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,'CCD' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId

,SRC.INSERTDTTM

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountStatus_DEP] AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
AS(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId   
,BDG.LAST_FREZ_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp   
,BDG.LAST_UNFREZ_DATE AS PeriodEndTimestamp   
,BDG.FREZ_CODE AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,NULL AS Customerid   
,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
From BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG WHERE BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;

--CHECH IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus 
WHERE (PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId,
	ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId,
    ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
    ,CASE 
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC SRC
    LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
	and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	and SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE (SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW) OR (TGT.HASHROW IS NULL)
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
    AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
    AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
    AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
    AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL OR TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' )

--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus
(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,Customerid
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId 
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp 
,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp 
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId 
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusNote AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SRC.Customerid AS Customerid 
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERTDTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON  DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;


END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS_LNS] AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus AS (

SELECT
    BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BLG.LAST_FREZ_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,CASE 
		WHEN BLG.LAST_UNFREZ_DATE >= BLG.LAST_FREZ_DATE THEN BLG.LAST_UNFREZ_DATE
		WHEN BLG.LAST_FREZ_DATE >= BLG.LAST_UNFREZ_DATE THEN BLG.LAST_FREZ_DATE
		END AS PeriodEndTimestamp
	,BLG.FREZ_CODE AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BLG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG
WHERE BLG.ISLATEST = 1
)

)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode

)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT
AS
(

HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(

,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus WHERE (PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' )
AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId,
    ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId,
    ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
and SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC

and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
 AND SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId

,InsertDttm)

,NULL AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId

,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC

AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
